Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients (men and nonpregnant women) with systemic hypertension and patients with hypercholesterolemia will be included
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is a male (meets gender requirement) and has documented hypercholesterolemia (LDL >190 mg/dL since age 45).

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Must be capable of rendering informed consent for all procedures
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information is provided about aspirin allergy or platelet count in the patient's profile.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is currently on metformin for diabetes mellitus type 2.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: No history of diabetes, peripheral vascular disease, coagulopathy, or vasculitis
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a documented history of diabetes mellitus type 2 diagnosed at age 48.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: No history of peripheral vascular disease, coagulopathy, or vasculitis
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information is provided about peripheral vascular disease, coagulopathy, or vasculitis in the patient's profile.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Must be capable of rendering informed consent for all procedures
